# `map_zip_with`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Merges two given maps into a single map by applying
function to the pair of values with the same key. For keys only presented in one map,
NULL will be passed as the value for the missing key. If an input map contains duplicated
keys, only the first entry of the duplicated key is passed into the lambda function.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
map_zip_with(map1, map2, function)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `lambda_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 3 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- map_zip_with, example 1
> SELECT map_zip_with(map(1, 'a', 2, 'b'), map(1, 'x', 2, 'y'), (k, v1, v2) -> concat(v1, v2));
{1:"ax",2:"by"}
```

```sql
-- map_zip_with, example 2
> SELECT map_zip_with(map('a', 1, 'b', 2), map('b', 3, 'c', 4), (k, v1, v2) -> coalesce(v1, 0) + coalesce(v2, 0));
{"a":1,"b":5,"c":4}
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 3.0.0.
